title: Vestiaire multi-brand lead search
description: Search public Vestiaire listings for several brands and aggregate sellers that appear across those brands.

brands.title: Brands or search phrases
brands.description: Distinct brand names or public search phrases. Use 3-5 focused brands for the first run.

country.title: Market
country.description: Vestiaire market used for URLs and localized pricing.

maxItemsPerBrand.title: Maximum listings per brand
maxItemsPerBrand.description: Maximum public listing cards retained for each brand.

maxPagesPerBrand.title: Maximum pages per brand
maxPagesPerBrand.description: Safety cap for search pagination. Vestiaire typically returns up to 48 listings per page.

minBrandCount.title: Minimum distinct brands per seller
minBrandCount.description: Only output sellers represented in at least this many searched brands.

minListingsPerSeller.title: Minimum matching listings per seller
minListingsPerSeller.description: Only output sellers with at least this many matching listings in the sampled results.

includeProducts.title: Include normalized product rows
includeProducts.description: Also write the product evidence used to build leads to the default Dataset.

maxConcurrency.title: Browser concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel brand search pages. Keep between 1 and 3 to reduce blocking.

maxRequestRetries.title: Maximum retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Maximum browser retries for a failed brand search.

navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Search response timeout
navigationTimeoutSecs.description: Seconds to wait for the public product-search response.

dedupeMode.title: Cross-run deduplication mode
dedupeMode.description: all emits every qualified lead; new_only emits unseen sellers; new_and_updated emits unseen sellers and sellers whose stable business/contact fields changed.

dedupeStoreName.title: Persistent deduplication store
dedupeStoreName.description: Named Apify key-value store used across runs. Use a different name to isolate independent campaigns.

reemitAfterDays.title: Re-emit unchanged leads after days
reemitAfterDays.description: Emit an otherwise unchanged seller after this many days. Set to 0 to never re-emit unchanged leads.

contactEnrichment.title: Enrich public business contacts
contactEnrichment.description: Discover likely official websites using Apify Google Search and extract only publicly displayed business emails, phone numbers, and social links from the website.
contactEnrichment.sectionDescription: This starts a paid Google Search Actor run for eligible leads. It does not use Google's personal-lead enrichment and does not attempt to identify private individuals.

maxContactEnrichmentLeads.title: Maximum leads to enrich
maxContactEnrichmentLeads.description: Maximum highest-scoring leads searched per run. Each uncached lead can add one Google search page plus public website requests.

minLeadScoreForEnrichment.title: Minimum lead score for enrichment
minLeadScoreForEnrichment.description: Only leads at or above this lead score are considered for contact enrichment.

minContactConfidence.title: Minimum verified contact confidence
minContactConfidence.description: Minimum evidence score required before a candidate website and its public contacts are marked verified.

contactCacheDays.title: Contact cache duration
contactCacheDays.description: Reuse contact evidence from the persistent state store for this many days before searching again.

contactSearchActorId.title: Search Actor ID
contactSearchActorId.description: Apify Actor used only to discover candidate official websites. Changing it requires compatible Google organic-result output.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Standard Apify proxy settings. Residential proxy matching the selected market is recommended for stable cloud runs.
